quiz.title: Conjuguaison : verbes réguliers, verbes irréguliers, temps de base
quiz.subject: Anglais

questions.question: Which of the following is a regular verb in English?
'The past tense of 'walk' is 'walked'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is an irregular verb in English?
'The past tense of 'run' is 'ran'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is the correct past tense form of 'eat'?
'The past tense of 'have' is 'had'' is a True statement.
Which of the following is the correct past participle form of 'go'?
'The past participle of 'go' is 'gone'' is a True statement.
